chain.conclusion: Merchant payments arrive via TWO paths: (1) directly funded by legacy xpub accounts (1,076 distinct addresses, external index up to 6,119 deep); (2) funded by bc1q/ltc1q addresses that are SELF_FORWARD destinations of the xpub accounts — i.e. the user's own native-segwit intermediate wallet. Path (2) is the majority by USD.
